description: Lead and campaign automation for NxtSend workspaces — leads, campaigns, sequences, inbox conversations and usage, via the NxtSend REST API v1.
label: NxtSend
notes: SKELETON. Make custom apps are built in the Make web interface or VS Code as component directories (Base / Connections / Modules) written in JSONC + IML — there is no single app.json file Make imports. This file is the spec for that build: use it (with base.json, connections/oauth2.json and modules/*.json) to create the app in Make, then submit it for review separately.
Replace <your-domain> with the deployment origin (e.g. https://nxtsend.com) everywhere before building.

No secrets live in this directory. The OAuth client_id / client_secret come from the one-time Dynamic Client Registration call (see docs/integrations/providers/automation-make.md) and are entered in Make, never committed here.
Auth: OAuth 2.0 against NxtSend's shared authorization server. Scopes: make.read make.write. There is no make.send tier — Make never sends LinkedIn messages.
Campaigns are created DRAFT ONLY; there is no launch module. There is no message-draft module. Inbox replies are email-channel only.
